program: FinTechCo x Claude Code — Applied AI Architect onsite (mock customer meeting)

budget.note: Sponsor left the budget blank. Default set by the orchestrator (ADR-002), sized from the fnol-platform program's actuals. Red flag at 80%.

concurrency.note: Harness caps each workflow at 2 concurrent agents on this 4-CPU container (ADR-000). Sprint 1 ran 4 workflows side by side (8 agents); agents are API-bound, CPU stayed low.

pricingSource: Anthropic first-party list prices, cached 2026-10-06 (claude-api skill). Cache-read rate for Haiku 5.5 assumed at 10% of input.
storyPoints: Fibonacci 1,2,3,5,8,13. Calibration: 1pt ≈ one focused document section or one file with tests; 5pt ≈ a leave-behind document or a demo act's code with tests; 8pt ≈ a full deliverable (deck build, demo repo) with its acceptance evidence.

performance.lowPerformer: bottom 10% by composite score, or below target two sprints running; fewer than 3 tickets = low confidence, no action

gates.G1: Narrative lock — orchestrator approves storyline and slide titles (end of Sprint 1)
gates.G2: Claims gate — every customer-facing factual claim maps to a verified or partially-verified CLM entry (Sprint 3)
gates.G3: Demo gate — each demo act passes a scripted dry-run, with a fallback for every live step (Sprint 3)
gates.G4: Timing gate — run-of-show rehearsed at <= 38 minutes with a cut list (Sprint 3)
gates.G5: Release — RTM 100% covered, artifacts published, PR open (Release)
